data.name: Sharwat
data.gender_notes: Sharwat is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharwat is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shar' which means 'spring' and 'wat' which means 'warmth' or 'joy'. This name signifies the arrival of spring, a time of new beginnings, renewal, and happiness. The name Sharwat carries the meaning “Spring, Warmth, Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharwat usually hope their child will grow to embody spring, warmth, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharwat is a divine name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It is believed to represent the grace and beauty of the goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, wisdom, and art. Sharwat is also associated with the sun god, Surya, who is a symbol of life, energy, and vitality.
data.etymology: Sharwat belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Spring, Warmth, Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharwat total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
